title: Evidence Item
description: Source material and its metadata. Evidence is stored as a reference to captured content, not reinterpreted. Evidence is never itself a claim, fact, or model output.

document_date.description: The issuance/revision date claimed by the source document itself, if any. Absence must be surfaced, never silently defaulted.

content_ref.description: Pointer to stored content (e.g. a fixture file path or content-addressed id). Never inline personally identifying content.

supersedes.description: evidence_id of a prior version, if this item is a revision. Older evidence must be retained, not overwritten.

is_synthetic.description: All committed evidence in this repository must be synthetic.
